## Implementation status report

### ✅ Completed phases

#### Phase 0: Color system refactoring — ~95% complete

#### Phase 1: Database schema — 100% complete
- ✅ All new fields added (streaks, statistics, seasonal)
- ✅ Database migration logic in `ratings.py`
- ✅ `reset_database.py` script exists and ready

#### Phase 2: Core rating system — 100% complete
- ✅ `INITIAL_RATING = 800` implemented
- ✅ Dynamic K-factor function (`get_k_factor()`) implemented
- ✅ `calculate_elo_change()` uses dynamic K-factor
- ✅ `record_game()` tracks all new statistics

#### Phase 3: Rank system — 100% complete
- ✅ `ranks.py` exists with all 14 ranks
- ✅ `get_rank()` and `get_rank_progress()` functions implemented
- ✅ Rank tracking in `record_game()` (peak_rank updates)

#### Phase 4: Achievements system — ~90% complete
- ✅ `achievements.py` exists with full system
- ✅ `/achievements` command implemented with category views
- ✅ Achievement checking after games (found in `game_handlers.py`)
- ⚠️ Need to verify all 87+ achievements are populated in database

#### Phase 5: Statistics & streaks — 100% complete
- ✅ Streak tracking (current_streak, best_streak)
- ✅ Enhanced statistics (best_rating, perfect_games, comeback_wins, etc.)
- ✅ All database fields updated in `record_game()`
